data.gender_notes: Konda is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Konda means bond, connection, or relation. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kri', meaning to do, and 'da', meaning friend. In Hindu mythology, Konda is also the name of a goddess, Kondamamba, who is the goddess of fertility and the protector of children. The name Konda carries the meaning “Bond, Connection” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Konda usually hope their child will grow to embody bond, connection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Konda belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bond, Connection.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Konda total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
